chapter_outcomes: Study the main events of the Prophet's life from his birth to his call to prophethood
Study the main events of his activities in Makka and his experiences with his opponents
Study the main events of his activities in Madina, his leadership of the community there and his conflicts with the Makkans and others
Study the importance of his actions as examples for Muslim individuals in their personal conduct and relations with others including women and non-Muslims
Study the importance of his actions as examples for Muslim communities in their relations with other states
Study his significance as Seal of the Prophets and last Messenger of God
Give accounts of the main events of the Prophet's life, and his significance in Muslim beliefs
Explain the importance of his actions and experiences in the history and beliefs of Islam, particularly in the way they provide examples for present day Muslim individuals and communities
